{{Quote|What brings a second rate bounty hunter like you to Tatooine?"''<br />''"The price on your head of course!|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and Sülphurr Cyander|<ref name="Spices & Spies">{{TCWComicCite|6.15|Spices & Spies}}</ref>}}
'''Sülphurr Cyander''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:SulphurrCyander-TheProfessional.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Sülphurr Cyander on [[Katalla]].]]
At some point, when he had already established his status as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], Sülphurr attended a [[Katalla casino|casino]] on [[Katalla]], which became bankrupt during his visit thanks to the [[Mission to Katalla|interventions]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].

During his time as a bounty hunter, he met the notorious [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], and soon after, Bane knew that he was one of his rivals.

When Cad Bane and [[Ttekket]] ran into Cyander again, Cyander [[Skirmish in Mos Espa|planned]] to turn the two into [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to collect the reward after they stole supplies from him. Cad Bane soon escaped, destroyed Cyander's [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and captured the bounty hunter. Cad Bane was going to throw him into Cyander's ship's engine when Ttekket had an idea. Cad blindfolded Cyander and contacted [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to tell him it was Cyander who stole the supplies. They left Cyander stranded on [[Chenini/Legends|Chenini]] to the Count's mercy, and took his ship and belongings.

==Equipment==
Cyander had [[crystal round]]s, that if added to a shot from his [[harmonic inducer]], created an impenetrable [[crystal prison]]. He also had a [[crystal cannon]] that could knock people out easily, and probably had more settings too. Cyander also had an [[R-41 Starchaser]]. [[Sülphurr Cyander's R-41 Starchaser]] was personalized and included the symbol Cyander had on his uniform.

==Behind the scenes==
Cyander's character was created as part of a competition in the comic. He was created by Benjamin Dawe.
